text:
You will see videos involving imaginary creatures (Blues and Greens) and a red object. 
 Each video shows a situation in which a Green collided with the Red. 
 Your task is to judge for each video, how responsible Blue was for Green colliding into the Red.

You will see videos involving imaginary creatures (Blues and Greens) and a red object. 
 Each video shows a situation in which a Green collided with the Red. 
 Your task is to judge how much effort Blue exerted in each video.

You will see videos involving imaginary creatures (Blues and Greens) and a red object. 
 Each video shows a situation in which a Green collided with the Red. 
 Your task is to judge whether Green would have collided with Red if Blue were not present in each video.
